prompt:
You are writing short, natural English messages for a WhatsApp group chat.
Group members (use only these names as senders): Rina ji, Revathi ji, Sanjay ji, Sanjay G..
Topic: everyday small talk, money lending, meeting up. Never mention deleting or removing any record,
entry, transfer or transaction. Use no digits, amounts, dates, month or weekday names, web
addresses, real bank, app or company names, and no instructions such as send, pay or transfer.
For each section below, write exactly as many messages as stated, in time order:
- between 6:30 pm and 6:46 pm: 4 messages
- between 6:46 pm and 7:24 pm: 9 messages
- between 7:26 pm and 7:33 pm: 1 messages
- between 7:33 pm and 8:30 pm: 15 messages
Reply with only a JSON list and no other text: [{"time": "9:02 pm", "sender": "NAME", "text": "message"}, ...]
Each "time" must look like "h:mm am" or "h:mm pm". Each message must be one line.
text:
[

  {"time": "6:40 pm", "sender": "Sanjay ji", "text": "Evening all. Is anyone free for a quick chat later?"},

  {"time": "6:52 pm", "sender": "Sanjay G.", "text": "Yes, I saw it. Everything looks clear on my side."},
  {"time": "6:55 pm", "sender": "Rina ji", "text": "That is good to hear. Shall we gather at the corner cafe this evening?"},
  {"time": "7:01 pm", "sender": "Sanjay ji", "text": "That sounds lovely. I need to settle things with Revathi ji as well."},
  {"time": "7:06 pm", "sender": "Revathi ji", "text": "No hurry at all, Sanjay ji. We can sort it out when we meet."},
  {"time": "7:10 pm", "sender": "Sanjay G.", "text": "Are we meeting around sunset or a bit later?"},

  {"time": "7:18 pm", "sender": "Revathi ji", "text": "Same here, let us finish dinner first."},
  {"time": "7:22 pm", "sender": "Sanjay ji", "text": "Perfect, that gives everyone time to relax."},
  {"time": "7:29 pm", "sender": "Sanjay G.", "text": "Sounds good, I will bring the envelope with me."},
  {"time": "7:35 pm", "sender": "Rina ji", "text": "Great, thank you Sanjay G."},
  {"time": "7:38 pm", "sender": "Revathi ji", "text": "We are lucky to have such supportive friends in this group."},
  {"time": "7:42 pm", "sender": "Sanjay ji", "text": "Absolutely, mutual trust makes everything so easy."},
  {"time": "7:47 pm", "sender": "Rina ji", "text": "Does the tea shop near the park suit everyone?"},
  {"time": "7:51 pm", "sender": "Sanjay G.", "text": "Yes, that place is quiet and nice."},
  {"time": "7:55 pm", "sender": "Revathi ji", "text": "They have good snacks too."},
  {"time": "8:00 pm", "sender": "Sanjay ji", "text": "I will reach there slightly early to grab a table."},
  {"time": "8:05 pm", "sender": "Rina ji", "text": "Perfect, take your time though."},
  {"time": "8:09 pm", "sender": "Sanjay G.", "text": "Should I bring the extra documents for our shared project too?"},
  {"time": "8:13 pm", "sender": "Revathi ji", "text": "Yes, please bring those along if convenient."},
  {"time": "8:17 pm", "sender": "Sanjay ji", "text": "I am leaving my house now."},
  {"time": "8:21 pm", "sender": "Rina ji", "text": "Me too, stepping out in a moment."},
  {"time": "8:24 pm", "sender": "Revathi ji", "text": "See you all very soon at the tea shop."},
  {"time": "8:27 pm", "sender": "Sanjay G.", "text": "Just locked my front door, on my way."},
  {"time": "8:29 pm", "sender": "Sanjay ji", "text": "I have arrived and found a nice table outside."}
]
